demonstration.narration: Traffic is steady, but this dashboard only counts requests with http.route. I'll search schema.route_present: false for missing routes, then check their producer and version.
demonstration.evidence: The hit count now shows requests recorded without http.route. These requests still happened, but a dashboard counting only requests with that field omits them. Next, one event will show which producer and version sent them.

drifts.note: You filtered on the producer ${action.value}; check which producer the records missing their route come from.

isolate.concept: Requests without a route still happened, but their http.route field is missing. A dashboard that counts only requests with that field leaves them out.
isolate.evidence: The hit count shows requests with no http.route. These requests still happened, but the route-based dashboard count leaves them out.

demonstration.narration: I'll open one missing-route request to check its producer and version together. That shows who sent a request without http.route.
demonstration.evidence: This one request has no route, and it was sent by ${param.incident.producer} on version ${param.incident.version}. ${truth.conclusion}
